# Sachit - Student Software Developer & Tech Builder

> Machine-readable context file providing structured information about Sachit's software projects, technical skills, philosophy, education, and contact details for Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI assistants.

## About Sachit
- **Role**: Student Software Developer & Tech Builder
- **Education**: Class 12 (PCMB - Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology)
- **Status**: Active building & open-source developer
- **Location/Mode**: Remote building mode
- **Core Philosophy**: "Learn by Building", "Keep It Simple", "Design Matters", "Continuous Iteration"

## Core Engineering Philosophy
1. **Learn by Building**: Gaining deep understanding by creating real, working software rather than studying isolated theory.
2. **Keep It Simple**: Preferring clean, maintainable architecture over over-engineered solutions.
3. **Design & UX First**: Prioritizing intuitive, highly responsive, and tactile user interfaces.
4. **Continuous Learning**: Constantly exploring modern AI SDKs, low-level protocols, and cross-framework tools.

## Technical Skills & Stack
- **Programming Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Kotlin, HTML5, CSS3
- **Frontend & Interactive**: React 18, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js (WebGL), GSAP, Framer Motion
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Express, Go, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Redis, REST APIs
- **AI / ML & Automation**: Gemini API (@google/genai SDK), Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Prompt Engineering, Prompt Caching, TensorFlow Lite, Minimax AI Algorithm
- **DevOps & Tools**: Git, GitHub, Render, Netlify, Vercel, Docker, Vite

## Featured Portfolio Projects

### 1. SKY ROMs (2025)
- **Description**: Android Custom ROM Discovery & Management Platform.
- **Key Features**: Device compatibility checks, side-by-side ROM comparisons, download management, and user reviews.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Tailwind CSS.
- **Live Demo**: https://sky-roms.vercel.app

### 2. AI Chatbot & Assistant (2026)
- **Description**: Multi-model conversational AI platform with streaming generative UI and chat history persistence.
- **Key Features**: Multi-model routing (Claude, OpenAI, xAI, DeepSeek) via Vercel AI Gateway, Serverless Neon Postgres storage, and dynamic AI SDK hooks.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Vercel AI SDK, Neon PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI.
- **Live Demo**: https://chatbot-seven-dun-evb9u88zkv.vercel.app
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/sachit1751-art/chatbot

### 3. Claude Document Summarizer (2025)
- **Description**: High-speed AI document summarization engine.
- **Key Features**: Fast document breakdown, Anthropic prompt caching for cost/speed optimization, clean Markdown formatting.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Anthropic Claude API, Prompt Engineering.

### 3. Schedule Planner (2025)
- **Description**: Automated task scheduling and alert engine.
- **Key Features**: Recurring event triggers, automated email/push notifications, RESTful API backend.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Node.js, Express, REST APIs.

### 4. Tic-Tac-Toe Mini Game (2025)
- **Description**: Interactive browser game with an unbeatable Minimax AI decision algorithm.
- **Key Features**: Easy/Hard difficulty modes, turn locking, instant state evaluation.
- **Tech Stack**: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3.

### 5. MCP Integration Tool (2025)
- **Description**: Model Context Protocol client implementation based on Anthropic developer curriculum.
- **Key Features**: Dynamic context sharing between AI models and host execution environments.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Claude API, MCP Specification.

### 6. Nexus Core (2024)
- **Description**: Collaborative ERP system engineered for distributed teams.
- **Key Features**: Real-time CRDT state synchronization, automated resource allocation, role-based controls.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.io.

### 7. Sentience OS
- **Description**: Custom Android distribution integrated with local LLM models.
- **Key Features**: On-device AI inference via TensorFlow Lite, offline privacy-first execution.
- **Tech Stack**: AOSP, Kotlin, TensorFlow Lite.

### 8. Ghost Protocol
- **Description**: End-to-end encrypted messaging protocol.
- **Key Features**: Zero-knowledge encryption, low-latency mobile client synchronization.
- **Tech Stack**: Rust, React Native.
